q: How fast will I see results?
a: Content goes live in week one. Engagement usually moves in the first month; paid campaigns can bring enquiries within days of launch. We review the numbers with you every month.

q: Do you work with clients outside India?
a: Yes. We work with brands across India and internationally, and bill in INR or USD. Shoots outside our base are planned with local crews or remote-first formats.

q: Can I take just one service?
a: Yes. Any service or option works on its own: only reels, only ads, only an app. We quote the combination if you want more than one.

q: Do I need a long contract?
a: No. Monthly plans can be cancelled with notice before the next cycle. Project work is quoted with a clear scope and timeline.

q: Who owns the raw footage, edits and ad accounts?
a: You do. Raw footage, final edits, ad accounts and automations stay yours, forever. We work inside your accounts wherever possible.

q: What happens on the free audit call?
a: We look at your page, competitors and goals, then send a 30-day plan with three quick wins, whether or not you hire us. No pitch deck, no pressure.

q: Is ad spend included in the price?
a: No. Ad spend is paid directly to Meta from your account, so you keep full control and visibility. Our fee covers strategy, creatives and management.
Every engagement is scoped on a short call, then quoted in writing. You get one price for the agreed scope, not an hourly meter. Quotes usually go out within two working days.

q: Can I upgrade a bundle later?
a: Yes. Starter, Growth and Scale are starting shapes. We re-scope and re-quote at the start of any cycle as your channels or product needs change.

q: How do shoots work if I am outside your base?
a: We plan a local crew and a remote director, or shoot in a compact setup that travels. Either way you get the same shot list, styling standard and edit quality.

q: How many revisions do I get?
a: Two rounds per edit or design deliverable are included. Beyond that we bill hourly, which is rare because we lock the direction before production.
